relations.product: development of the engine for precision-guided munitions (MOU; LIG D&A develops the PGM system)
relations.quote: LIG D&A will be handling development of the precision-guided munitions system, while Doosan Enerbility will be taking on development of the engine to be deployed in the system.
relations.label: Doosan Enerbility press release: Doosan Enerbility Signs Precision-Guided Munitions (10-20-2026)
